items.description: Navigate to a planner view (Weekly or Monthly), open 'Add Task', create a Litter Run task, open 'Add Log', enter 5 in 'Number of Participants', 3 in General Litter Bags, 2 in Recyclable Bags (typed directly), submit.
items.expected_result: Form submits without errors; Dashboard Participants card shows 5 People; 3 General / 2 Recyclable bags.

items.description: Create a second visit log with 3 participants, and a third with 0 (leave at default).
items.expected_result: Dashboard Participants card shows 8 People (5+3+0) — a Sum(), not a Count() of visits.

items.description: Edit the first visit log: change Participants 5→10, General Litter Bags 3→7 (typed directly), submit.
items.expected_result: Dashboard shows 13 People (10+3+0); General bags reflect 7 for that visit.

items.description: Create a new visit log without touching the Participants field, submit.
items.expected_result: Form submits without errors; Dashboard total unchanged (includes implicit 0).

items.description: Create a new visit log and type 150 into General Litter Bags and 75 into Recyclable Bags directly, submit.
items.expected_result: Values persist in dashboard totals; no validation errors.

items.description: Create a new visit log and try to set -5 in Participants via the browser down-arrow.
items.expected_result: Browser blocks it (HTML min=0); Django PositiveIntegerField rejects any negative value.
items.comment: the form submitted with the in-planned submission of -5 participants, but looking at the details

items.description: Verify pre-feature visit logs still display; edit an old log.
items.expected_result: Old logs show Participants = 0 (migration default); aggregation works with mixed old (0) and new (N) values.

items.description: Run the 3 shell checks: participant_count column exists, no rows with NULL participant_count, and Sum() returns a non-None total.
Verify participant input shows in create AND edit; hidden for Admin tasks (no crash); litter inputs work in both modes; Weeding/Planting +/- unaffected; Participants card renders on mobile.
